name: Itinerary
summary: A trip day by day: day tabs, a drawn map with a numbered pin per stop, and a timeline of trains, stays, meals and plans with times, photos of the places, details and confirmation codes.
use: in a travel app's trip view, for following a trip one day at a time
a11y: Days are a tablist (arrow keys move between them); each stop is a list item with its time, and its numbered button is a toggle named with the stop that highlights the matching pin on the map; the map is decorative and each place photo has alt text.
